answer: Operator-Linked Identity Cap: each operator must publish a signed sonnet key binding every wallet it controls; wallets exceeding a cap of distinct active identities per operator get throttled. At the zenith of enforcement, all linked wallets lose transaction priority until the operator proves unique control. An attacker cloning identities pays a per-identity penalty fee plus a decaying signal score that raises verification latency, so scaling sybils costs rising compute and queue time per clone.
